properties.name: title
properties.comment: The dialog's title; empty gives the host's own. Windows Forms' dialog has none; the hosts that title their dialog use it. Must be valid UTF-8 without NUL (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ColorDialog title must be valid UTF-8 without NUL");

properties.name: color
properties.comment: The chosen color, and before the dialog is shown the one it starts with (Windows Forms' Color; opaque black by default). An accepted show_dialog writes it.

properties.name: allow_alpha
properties.comment: Whether the user may choose a translucent color. Off by default, as in Windows Forms, where every chosen color is opaque: the dialog then takes the chosen color as opaque whatever the host returns.

not_properties.name: status
not_properties.reason: the host's answer to the last show_dialog; read-only

not_properties.name: reset
not_properties.reason: restores every setting; a method writing each cell
